rules.label: kept_owner
rules.why: Review R4b S4: the MSI defaults (USE_MU=1 / ENABLE_MU=1) opt the machine into Microsoft Update (service 7971F918-...). Windows Update state that other products' updates use; the uninstall leaves it and it must stay. Seen in both m1b-freeze runs (2026-11-17).

rules.label: kept_owner
rules.why: Windows Update's default-service value, written with the Microsoft Update opt-in above and left by the uninstall (both m1b-freeze runs, 2026-11-17): Windows Update state, must stay.

note: PowerShell 7.6.10 LTS x64 MSI (M1b, M1B-RIG-HOST). Launched once (pwsh.exe -NoLogo). Hand rules: the MSI containers and the per-user PowerShell folders that hold user data. Frozen 2026-11-17 (truth/frozen/powershell). R4b S4: the Microsoft Update opt-in (service key and DefaultService) is kept_owner, seen in both m1b-freeze runs (2026-11-17).
